sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No candidate is the canonical stringer class required by the feedback; the supplied candidates represent frame and web frame only.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The applicability target creates accidental-pass logic: sh:targetSubjectsOf nltl:hasEffectiveMemberCrossSection selects only members that already have the link, while the link constraint itself has no sh:minCount, so an applicable frame, stringer, or web frame with no effective cross section is never checked. Locate and use the canonical applicability classes/terms for the frames, stringers, and web frames governed by 4.4–4.6, target those members independently, and require exactly the needed nltl:hasEffectiveMemberCrossSection value with sh:minCount 1 and the stated range/class. Retain the sectionModulus and shearArea checks on that linked effective cross section and the conditional classification-society evidence check when memberNormalToPlating is false.

Targeting only nltl:webFrame omits the expressly applicable frames and stringers. Locate the canonical frame and stringer classes and target all three member types. Prevent accidental bypass of the non-normal-member condition by requiring exactly one xsd:boolean memberNormalToPlating value, then require the classification-society calculation evidence and ship-component context when that value is false. Also remove sh:maxCount 1 from hasEffectiveMemberCrossSection unless exclusive cardinality is independently verified; the clause requires use of the effective cross section but does not explicitly establish exactly one linked node.

The applicability is incomplete: the requirement covers frames, stringers, and web frames, but the shape targets only frame and webFrame. Locate the canonical stringer class and add it as a target while preserving the effective-cross-section and conditional classification-society evidence constraints.
